Recorded claim:
Review isolation uses the standalone sibling clone `Review comm checkout`, not a Git worktree. For a new large clone, `git clone --reference SOURCE --dissociate REMOTE DEST` avoids the full-history transfer while producing a self-contained repository; verify clean `main`, canonical remotes, no alternates/shallow markers, and `git fsck --connectivity-only --no-dangling`. [Task 1]
